Sokoban teaching level attribution

The 26 teaching layouts in games/sokoban/tutorial-data.js were imported from:
https://github.com/shunyue1320/sokoban/blob/master/js/mapdata100.js

The reference repository publishes this project under the MIT License. Entries
7–23, 25, 30 and 31 are included alongside the first six entries as the 26
teaching maps; the current project redraws them with its own Canvas materials.
